vinicius-portfolio.framing: Monorepo for this portfolio: FastAPI + Socket.IO backend and React 19 (Vite) frontend with Live Lab and admin chat.
vinicius-portfolio.architecture: backend/ (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, seed scripts) and interfaces/web/ (React, TanStack Query, styled-components, i18n).
vinicius-portfolio.decision: Single deployable product with honest project entries sourced from portfolio_catalog.py — titles equal GitHub repo names.

ReactGram.framing: CRA app under reactgram/: Instagram-style feed with auth, posts, likes, Redux Toolkit, and json-server on data/db.json.
ReactGram.architecture: React Router pages (Home, Login, Register, Profile, Publish), useAuth hook, and mock REST via npm run server.
ReactGram.decision: Describe the social UI and mock API as implemented — not a production backend separate from json-server.

tasks-flask-crud.framing: Flask API storing tasks in a Python list: full CRUD on /tasks with a Task model and pytest in tests.py.
tasks-flask-crud.architecture: Single app.py with in-memory tasks[]; models/task.py serializes to JSON — no SQLAlchemy or MySQL.
tasks-flask-crud.decision: State clearly that persistence is in-memory so expectations match the repository code.

sample-flask-auth.framing: Flask auth API (README: authentication with database): login/logout, bcrypt users, MySQL via SQLAlchemy.
sample-flask-auth.architecture: Flask-Login sessions; User model; routes for login, user CRUD, and role-based 403 on forbidden operations.
sample-flask-auth.decision: Align copy with MySQL + Flask-Login in app.py — credentials in repo are for local dev only.
